events.title: Flight to Kochi
events.details: Air India AI-512 from BLR, arrives at Cochin (COK) at 10:15.

events.title: Check in at Brunton Boatyard
events.details: Colonial maritime heritage hotel overlooking the harbor.

events.title: Chinese Fishing Nets & Fort Kochi Beach
events.details: Iconic cantilevers dating back to the 14th century. Sunset walk and fresh seafood at street vendors.

events.title: Mattancherry Palace & Dutch Museum
events.details: Featuring exquisite Kerala murals depicting the Ramayana.

events.title: Jew Town & Paradesi Synagogue
events.details: Oldest active synagogue in the Commonwealth and antique spice market. Savor Kerala Parotta with beef/veg roast.

events.title: Kathakali Performance at Kerala Cultural Centre
events.details: Live classical dance-drama with traditional makeup ritual demonstration.

events.title: Alleppey Backwaters Day Excursion
events.details: Private day cruise on a traditional thatched houseboat through palm-fringed canals with Karimeen lunch.

events.title: Marine Drive Promenade & Shopping
events.details: Tea and Kerala spice shopping near Broadway.

events.title: Flight to Bengaluru
events.details: Air India AI-519 from COK, arrives at BLR at 19:45.
